name: Linear voltage regulators
summary: Three-pin linear regulators that give a fixed or adjustable DC voltage from a higher one.
identify: Three-legged parts, often on heatsinks, marked 7805, 7812, LM317, AMS1117 or similar, on almost every board.
test: Feed a higher voltage in and the output should match the marking. A 78xx needs about 2V more in than out.
